roleContext.jobDescription: A finance-software company for small businesses is expanding its expense-management product. The product manager writes requirements with acceptance criteria, runs discovery and usability research, works with design and engineering in two-week sprints and tracks adoption in product analytics. The hire will own the expense-capture roadmap, so the company is looking for someone who has already owned a product roadmap, set its priorities and made the launch decisions. The product team has three squads, each with a product manager, a designer and five engineers, and the product managers report to the chief product officer.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Product Manager, Expense Management

## Experience

- At the 2023 company all-hands at Tallyline, the chief product officer thanked the candidate as 'the person who owned the receipt-scanning roadmap' and said the candidate 'called every launch on it'.
- Associate product manager at Tallyline from 2022 to 2024, supporting the group product manager responsible for receipt scanning and expense capture, in a squad of one designer and five engineers.
- Wrote user stories and acceptance criteria for the receipt-scanning features and refined them with the design and engineering leads before each two-week sprint.
- Ran twelve usability sessions with small-business bookkeepers on the receipt-upload flow and summarised the findings for the group product manager's quarterly roadmap review.
- Built the feature-adoption dashboard in Amplitude, tracking weekly active scanners and the completion rate of the upload flow, and shared it with the squad each week.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the product requirements document for multi-receipt upload, listing the candidate as author, the group product manager as approver and the acceptance criteria agreed with engineering.
